title: 8.1.11 Project: Desk Tray
description: Put it all together: a box, hollowed into a tray, with one softened edge. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Add the box
steps.instructions: Press the Box tool. In the Dimensions panel, type 80 in width and 50 in depth. Height already reads 20, so leave it. (On the Code side this step is one line: const b = box(80, 50, 20).)
hints: This is the same first step as every box you've built this unit - just three different numbers.

steps.title: Hollow it into a tray
steps.instructions: Click the top face, then press Hollow. In the Dimensions panel, wall reads 2 - type 2.5, so the walls are 2.5 mm thick.
hints: A message under the 3D view should read "Hollow 1 is open at the top face." That's what makes it a tray instead of a sealed block.

On the Code side, hollow(b, { wall: 2.5, open: 'top' }) is the same step. open takes a face word in quotes. Without it you get a sealed block, and the Quest will complain about the hollow even though it shows a 2.5 wall.

steps.title: Drill a drain hole through the floor
steps.instructions: Click the tray in the 3D view, then press the Hole tool. A hole appears going down through the floor of the tray. In the Dimensions panel, the diameter reads 6 - type 12.
hints: Click on the outside of the long front wall, near the middle.
The new step shows up in the timeline as "HOLE 1".
On the Code side the same step is one line: hole(b, { across: 12 }).

requirements.title: An 80 x 50 x 20 tray with 2.5 mm walls and a 12 mm hole
requirements.description: An 80 x 50 x 20 mm box, hollowed to 2.5 mm walls with the top open, with a 12 mm hole drilled through the floor.
requirements.hint: Box 80 x 50 x 20, Hollow wall 2.5 open top, then Hole with diameter 12.
